title: SQL Injection Prevention
description: Guidelines to prevent SQL injection in web applications.
precautions: Never concatenate untrusted input into SQL strings
Enforce least-privilege accounts for database access
Validate and sanitize all user inputs
Enable database auditing and anomaly alerts
steps: Refactor database access layer to use prepared statements
Add input validation utilities for common fields
Create unit tests for injection payloads
Configure WAF rules for SQLi signatures

title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Defense
description: Best practices to mitigate reflected, stored, and DOM-based XSS.
precautions: Escape output in HTML, JS, and attributes
Use a templating engine that auto-escapes
Sanitize rich-text inputs on both client and server
steps: Audit all user-generated content render paths
Add a strict CSP with nonce-based scripts
Introduce a sanitization library for HTML inputs

title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Protection
description: Prevent unauthorized state-changing requests via CSRF tokens and SameSite cookies.
precautions: Use anti-CSRF tokens on state-changing endpoints
Use double-submit cookie pattern if needed
steps: Add CSRF middleware to your web framework
Annotate POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE routes to require tokens
Configure cookie attributes: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite
Write integration tests covering token validation
Review third-party integrations for CSRF risks

title: Brute Force and Credential Stuffing Mitigation
description: Reduce account takeover risk via rate limiting, MFA, and detection.
precautions: Apply adaptive rate limiting and IP reputation
Use password hashing with strong parameters (Argon2/Bcrypt)
Monitor login anomalies and lockout policies
Deploy bot detection on authentication endpoints
steps: Upgrade hash parameters and rehash on login
Instrument anomaly alerts on auth events

title: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) Resilience
description: Architect defenses against volumetric and application-layer DDoS.
precautions: Separate read/write paths and cache aggressively
Proxy critical endpoints behind rate-limited gateways
steps: Instrument traffic baselines and anomaly alerts

title: Privilege Escalation and Least Privilege
description: Prevent lateral movement and escalation via strict RBAC and auditing.

title: Phishing and Social Engineering Awareness
description: Reduce phishing risk via training, email security, and verification.
steps: Audit domain records for email authentication

title: Ransomware Preparedness
description: Prepare for ransomware via backups, segmentation, and detection.
precautions: Monitor for encryption and exfiltration behaviors
Plan incident response and legal contacts
steps: Set up honey files and tripwires

title: Secure Configuration and Misconfiguration Prevention
description: Avoid insecure defaults and drift via baselines and continuous validation.
precautions: Scan for public exposure in cloud services

title: API Security Fundamentals
description: Protect APIs via authentication, authorization, input validation, and monitoring.
precautions: Use JWT with short TTL and rotation
steps: Add schema validation and error handling
Set up API monitoring and alerts
